$comment: How a ${VAR} in a knowledge base's config resolves — shared by the TypeScript config loader (packages/core, toml-loader.ts resolveEnvVars) and the Go launcher (apps/launcher, which resolves the gateway's configuration document). Both run every case; a change to the rule changes this table first.

cases.why: a set variable replaces its reference
text without a reference is itself
every reference in a value is resolved
an unset variable with a default takes the default
a set variable wins over its default
a variable set to the empty string is set
an unset variable with no default refuses, naming it
